```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

expr_path  <- "raw_counts_200samples.csv"
annot_path <- "annotation.tsv"

# 1) Read files
expr  <- read.csv(expr_path, check.names = FALSE)
annot <- read_tsv(annot_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Make sure GeneID types match
expr$GeneID  <- as.character(expr$GeneID)
annot$GeneID <- as.character(annot$GeneID)

# 2) Join annotation onto expression
expr_anno <- expr %>%
  left_join(annot %>% select(GeneID, Symbol, EnsemblGeneID, Description, GeneType),
            by = "GeneID")

# 3) Quick checks
cat("Total rows in expr:", nrow(expr), "\n")
cat("Mapped to Symbol:", sum(!is.na(expr_anno$Symbol) & expr_anno$Symbol != ""), "\n")
cat("Unmapped:", sum(is.na(expr_anno$Symbol) | expr_anno$Symbol == ""), "\n")

# OPTIONAL: view a few unmapped IDs
head(expr_anno %>% filter(is.na(Symbol) | Symbol == "") %>% select(GeneID) %>% distinct(), 10)

# 4) If you want a SYMBOL x sample matrix (recommended for readability):
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(expr_anno), c("GeneID","Symbol","EnsemblGeneID","Description","GeneType"))

expr_symbol <- expr_anno %>%
  filter(!is.na(Symbol), Symbol != "") %>%
  group_by(Symbol) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

# Save it
write.csv(expr_symbol, "expression_matrix_SYMBOL.csv", row.names = FALSE)
